text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot Meisho Doto in the hallway. She looks awfully tired.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, why is there a bucket here? Huh, and a m-mop, too?! It's all knocked o—nooo, not the window!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She collides with about every object that falls in her path. This looks like a bad case of fatigue.
